top 5 tips to start your healthy hair care journey🌱✨ 1. cut off those split ends✂️      split ends can’t be repaired, only temporarily sealed. if you leave them, they can continue splitting farther up the hair shaft, leading to more breakage over time. regular trims help keep your hair looking thicker and healthier while preventing you from losing more length later. 2. do a 10 minute scalp massage daily💆🏼‍♀️      your scalp is skin, and healthy hair starts there. daily scalp massages can help increase blood flow to the scalp, reduce buildup, and create a healthier environment for your hair to grow. you can use your fingertips or a scalp massager. just be gentle and consistent. 3. start scalp + hair oiling🫶      find the right hair oil for your scalp and hair type because not every oil works for everyone. i oil my scalp for density, not to make my hair grow faster. massage it in for a few minutes 1 to 3 times a week before wash day, then wash it out after 3 to 4 hours if your scalp tolerates it well. i also have other videos that go into all the do’s and don’ts of hair oiling if you want to learn more. 4. get a blood panel done🩸      if your hair feels thinner than normal, sheds excessively, or isn’t growing like it used to, it may be worth asking your doctor for blood work. things like low iron, vitamin d, b12, zinc, or other deficiencies can affect hair health. if you’re deficient, focus on vitamin rich foods and only take supplements if recommended by your healthcare provider. 5. learn your hair before buying products🤍      figure out your hair pattern (straight, wavy, curly, or coily), strand texture (fine, medium, or coarse), porosity (how well your hair absorbs and holds moisture), and scalp type (oily, dry, balanced, or sensitive). once you know those, it’s much easier to build a routine that actually works for you instead of wasting money on products that aren’t a good fit. healthy hair isn’t about buying the most expensive products. it’s about understanding your hair, staying consistent, and being patient. 🤍   #haircare #healthyhair #HairCareTips #kayliboyle

✨ Part 2: 5 more things I’d do if I had to start my healthy hair journey from scratch: 6. Stop sleeping with wet hair. Instead put some night serums, loose braid and sleep on silk pillowcase ✨ (my favorite)  7. Wash my scalp when it actually needs it. A clean, healthy scalp creates the best environment for healthy hair. If your hair requires to wash it every day, do it. 🤍 8. Eat enough protein and make sure I’m not ignoring things like iron or vitamin deficiencies. Hair health starts from within, too.  9. Accept that healthy hair takes time. Growth is slow, but damage can happen fast. Be patient with the process. 10. Take progress photos. You see your hair every day, so it’s easy to miss the little improvements that add up over time. The biggest difference between girls who eventually have healthy hair and the ones who don’t? They don’t quit after two weeks. They keep showing up. Wash after wash. Brush after brush. Tiny habit after tiny habit. One day you look in the mirror and realize your hair didn’t change overnight—it changed because you stayed consistent. ✨🤍 #haircare #healthyhair #HairCareTips #hairjourney #naturalblonde

Skincare Ingredients — AM☀️ vs PM🌙 Wondering if you're using your skincare at the right time? Here's a pharmacist’s guide to AM vs PM skincare timing ⏰ ☀️ Vitamin C - AM > PM → Pairs with SPF to fight free radical damage from UV exposure ☀️ Niacinamide - AM > PM → Flexible ingredient, but in the morning it calms skin and balances oil before sunscreen and makeup 🔄 Hyaluronic Acid - AM & PM → Works 24/7. Must apply on damp skin to lock in deep hydration 🔄 Ceramides - AM & PM → Essential for barrier repair, especially after using retinoids or acids 🌙 Retinol - PM only → It breaks down in sunlight and increases sun sensitivity 🌙 Salicylic Acid - AM < PM → Works either time, but preferred at night to deep-clean pores while the skin regenerates overnight 🌙 Lactic Acid - PM only → Gentle AHA that exfoliates surface cells but increases sun sensitivity  Save this for your next skincare routine — and follow for Part 2 ✨ #skintok #niacinamide #retinol #skincareroutine #hyaluronicacid

컨테이너 밑에서 벌벌 떨며 살아가던 이름 없는 야외 마당 강아지. 1차 환경개선 이후에도 눈 상태가 계속 마음에 걸려 견주분을 설득한 끝에 병원 진료를 허락받을 수 있었습니다. 겁이 많은 아이는 안전하게 이동장에 태운 뒤 병원으로 이동하였고, 마침 쉬는 날이었음에도 감사하게도 수의사님께서 직접 진료를 봐주셨습니다. 아이의 체중은 약 3.5kg, 나이는 1~2살 정도로 추정되는 여자아이였습니다. 가장 먼저 걱정했던 눈 상태를 확인한 결과 다행히 심각한 질환은 아니었고 습진으로 인한 증상이라는 진단을 받았습니다. 안약을 처방받아 꾸준히 관리하면 충분히 좋아질 수 있다고 하셨습니다. 이후 심장사상충 검사를 위해 채혈을 진행했고, 안타깝게도 아이에게 심장사상충이 확인되었습니다. 심장사상충은 꾸준한 치료와 관리가 필요한 질환으로 앞으로 한 달 이상 치료를 받아야 하는 상황이었습니다. 진료를 마친 뒤 견주분께 현재 상태를 자세히 설명드렸지만 견주분께서는 혼자 생활하고 계셔 지속적인 치료와 관리를 이어가기 어려운 상황이었고, 야외 생활을 하는 환경에서는 사실상 치료를 진행하기 쉽지 않은 상황이었습니다. 하지만 아이는 밥도 정말 잘 먹고, 어려운 환경 속에서도 묵묵히 하루하루를 버텨내고 있었습니다. 현재 아이는 심장사상충 치료와 함께 새로운 가족을 찾고 있습니다. 겁이 많지만 순하고 착한 아이이며, 이제는 더 이상 컨테이너 밑이 아닌 따뜻한 집에서 사랑받으며 살아갈 수 있었으면 좋겠습니다. 🐾 이 아이와 평생을 함께해 주실 가족을 찾고 있습니다. 📩 문의 : rltjddlrk12@gmail.com 아이가 건강을 회복하고 행복한 가족을 만날 수 있도록 많은 관심과 응원 부탁드립니다. ❤️ 🐾 햅독의 작은 부탁이 있습니다. 평소 쿠팡에서 구매할 물건이 있으셨다면 상단 프로필 링크를 통해 접속 후 24시간 내 아무 상품이나 구매해 주세요. 여러분의 구매로 발생한 수수료는 쿠팡으로부터 햅독에 지급되며, 이렇게 모인 수수료는 시골 강아지들의 사료와 간식, 더 나은 환경을 만들어주는 데 사용됩니다. 여러분의 작은 관심이 아이들에게는 큰 행복이 됩니다. 오늘도 함께해 주셔서 진심으로 감사합니다. 🧡
